WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM trader_type_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tradekind,
  tc.count,
  CAST(tc.count AS REAL) / t.total_count as proportion,
  tc.count - t.avg_count as count_minus_avg
FROM trader_type_counts tc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE t.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND tc.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY tc.tradekind
